title: The Reserve Bank of India's Domestic Money Transfer Directions, 2026 (RBI/DPSS/2026-27/476, dated and in force from 11 Nov 2026) keep the cash-transfer limits unchanged since the RBI's 5 Oct 2011 circular (₹5,000 a transaction and ₹25,000 a month per sender through BC agents and ATMs; ₹10,000 a pay-out and ₹25,000 a month per receiver) plus up to ₹50,000 of branch cash by NEFT, and carry over the July 2024 checks (verified mobile number and self-certified OVD, an additional factor of authentication on every transfer, sender details and a cash identifier in the IMPS/NEFT message), replacing the 2011 and 2024 circulars.
